changelog: v1.1.0 — Major expansion from an instruction-only skill into a full operator playbook. Added a Quick Reference decision table (Strong/Acceptable/Weak), a Solves section, a detailed 7-step workflow, two fully worked examples with realistic data, and an expanded common-mistakes section. Added reference files (references/output-template.md, references/scenario-library.md, references/tone-and-policy-guide.md) and a 47-item quality checklist (assets/quality-checklist.md).
summary: Build a pre-written response library for common customer service inquiries, complaints, and order issues that maintains tone and reduces resolution time.
